description: Source code for MainActivity.java, an Android activity demonstrating the use of MediaRouter API to display content on a secondary display, manage media routes, and control presentation displays.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity manages media routing and presentation display for secondary screens using the MediaRouter API, including callback handling, UI updates, and presentation control.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity view, sets up UI components, and obtains the MediaRouter system service.

methods.name: updatePresentation
methods.description: Updates or creates a presentation on a secondary display based on the current routing state.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Registers media route callback and updates presentation state when activity resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Removes media route callback registration when activity pauses.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Dismisses the presentation when activity stops.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu and configures the MediaRouteActionProvider for media routing.

methods.name: showNextColor
methods.description: Changes the color displayed on the secondary display if a presentation is active.
